function_declarations.name: coinvello_create_checkout_session
function_declarations.description: Create a CoinVello hosted checkout session: an invoice plus a payment page at pay.coinvello.com. Redirect the customer to the returned `url`; fulfil the order on the `invoice.paid` webhook, never on the redirect. CoinVello is non-custodial: funds go straight to the merchant's wallet.

amount.description: Total to charge as a decimal string, e.g. "49.99".

currency.description: ISO 4217 fiat code (USD, EUR, GBP...) or an asset id (btc:bitcoin) to price in crypto.

items.description: Asset id <asset>:<chain>, e.g. btc:bitcoin, eth:ethereum, usdc:polygon, usdt:tron, eurc:base. Must be listed by GET /assets for the key's mode (some tokens, such as DAI, are live-only).

accepted_assets.description: Assets the customer may pay with. Defaults to every asset with an enabled wallet.

order_id.description: Your order reference. Indexed and searchable.

success_url.description: Where the hosted page sends the customer after payment.

tax.description: The tax portion of the sale as you computed it: a decimal string in the invoice currency, included in `amount`. Copied to the invoice's records and exports. jurisdiction is a region code you choose (DE, US-CA), never anything about the payer.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "49.99". Never a float.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks. Pass as a JSON object string.

unit_amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "49.99". Never a float.

redirect_on.description: When the hosted page redirects to success_url. Default confirming.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_create_invoice
function_declarations.description: Create a bare CoinVello invoice when you render the payment UI yourself. Returns `hosted_url` and `payment_options[]` with a merchant-owned `address`, exact `amount`, `payment_uri` (BIP-21 / EIP-681 / Solana Pay) and `qr_payload` per asset.

amount.description: Total to charge as a decimal string, e.g. "49.99".

currency.description: ISO 4217 fiat code (USD, EUR, GBP...) or an asset id (btc:bitcoin) to price in crypto.

items.description: Asset id <asset>:<chain>, e.g. btc:bitcoin, eth:ethereum, usdc:polygon, usdt:tron, eurc:base. Must be listed by GET /assets for the key's mode (some tokens, such as DAI, are live-only).

accepted_assets.description: Assets the customer may pay with. Defaults to every asset with an enabled wallet.

order_id.description: Your order reference. Indexed and searchable.

success_url.description: Where the hosted page sends the customer after payment.

tax.description: The tax portion of the sale as you computed it: a decimal string in the invoice currency, included in `amount`. Copied to the invoice's records and exports. jurisdiction is a region code you choose (DE, US-CA), never anything about the payer.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "49.99". Never a float.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks. Pass as a JSON object string.

rate_lock.description: Hold crypto amounts fixed until expiry. Default true.

required_confirmations.description: Per-asset override, e.g. {"btc:bitcoin": 2}. Pass as a JSON object string.

underpayment_tolerance.description: Fraction that may be missing and still count as paid, e.g. "0.01". Default 0.5%.

overpayment_tolerance.description: Fraction above which the invoice is overpaid. Default 2%.

payment_options_mode.description: all = derive an address per asset now; single = derive when the customer picks.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_get_invoice
function_declarations.description: Retrieve a CoinVello invoice by id (inv_...) to check `status` (new, pending, confirming, paid, underpaid, overpaid, expired, cancelled, refund_requested), `paid` summary and `payment_options`. Use for polling or reconciliation.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_list_invoices
function_declarations.description: List CoinVello invoices newest first with optional filters. Returns { object: "list", data: [...], has_more, next_cursor }.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_create_webhook
function_declarations.description: Register a CoinVello webhook endpoint. The response includes `secret` (whsec_...) exactly once; store it to verify the CoinVello-Signature header (t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>"). Live URLs must be HTTPS; test mode allows http://localhost.

events.description: Event types or ["*"]. Common: invoice.paid, invoice.confirming, invoice.underpaid, invoice.overpaid, invoice.expired, payment.detected, checkout_session.completed.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks. Pass as a JSON object string.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_simulate_test_payment
function_declarations.description: Test mode only (cv_test_ key). Create a synthetic payment for an invoice (inv_) or credit purchase (cpu_) and run it through the real state machine and webhook pipeline. confirmations >= the asset's required confirmations marks the invoice paid; a smaller/larger amount simulates underpaid/overpaid.

asset.description: Payment option to pay. Defaults to the first accepted asset.

amount.description: Amount in the asset. Defaults to the exact payment_options[].amount.

tx_hash.description: Reuse to advance the same payment instead of adding a second one.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_list_records
function_declarations.description: List the CoinVello book of record, newest first: one immutable row per movement of value (payment_received, fee_prepaid, credit_purchase, refund_sent, fee_onchain, conversion, offramp_payout...) valued when it happened. Each record has `value` (market value at the block time in the reporting currency, with rate and source), `value_usd`, `contract_value` (what the customer owed at the invoice's locked rate), `tax`, the on-chain proof and an invoice snapshot. Returns { object: "list", data: [...], has_more, next_cursor }. With a test key, simulated payments need include_simulated=true.

asset.description: Records whose received, sent or fee leg is this asset.

occurred_gte.description: Block time at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

occurred_lte.description: Block time at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

currency.description: Re-value `value` into this currency from value_usd at the historical rate. Default: the account's reporting currency.

include_simulated.description: Test mode only: include rows created by /test/simulate_payment, which the sandbox hides by default. Ignored with a live key.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_get_records_summary
function_declarations.description: Totals for a period from the CoinVello book of record: sales (at the locked rates), received_market_value, valuation_difference, tax_collected, refunds, fees_prepaid and credits_consumed, fees_onchain, network_fees, credit_purchases, net_received and payment counts, over occurred_at in the given timezone and currency. period_start is inclusive, period_end exclusive. group_by returns the same totals per month, asset, chain, type or address in `groups`.

period_start.description: Inclusive, read in `timezone`: a date (2026-01-01) or a date-time.

period_end.description: Exclusive: a date (2027-01-01) or a date-time.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD or EUR.

timezone.description: IANA zone used to bucket occurred_at, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default: the account's records timezone.

include_simulated.description: Test mode only: include rows created by /test/simulate_payment, which the sandbox hides by default. Ignored with a live key.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_create_export
function_declarations.description: Create a CoinVello export: a CSV, Excel (xlsx) or JSON file of the records (default), another dataset, or `all` (the year-end package), for a period or the entire history (period null). Returns the export object; small exports are already `ready` with `file` (name, content_type, bytes, sha256) and a signed `download_url` (kept 7 days); otherwise poll coinvello_get_export. Vendor presets (quickbooks, xero, koinly, cointracker, coinledger) and journal need dataset=records and format=csv, else 422. Verify the download against file.sha256.

preset.description: Column layout for the records dataset. Default generic.

period.description: Read in `timezone`; start inclusive, end exclusive. Null or omitted exports the entire history.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. America/New_York. Default: the account's records timezone.

currency.description: Reporting currency of the value columns.

include_simulated.description: Test mode only: include rows created by /test/simulate_payment, which the sandbox hides by default. Ignored with a live key.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks. Pass as a JSON object string.

function_declarations.name: coinvello_get_export
function_declarations.description: Retrieve a CoinVello export (exp_...): status (queued, processing, ready, failed, expired), rows, file { name, content_type, bytes, sha256 }, download_url, download_expires_at and failure_reason. Poll after coinvello_create_export until ready.
